transcript: If I told you that cats don't approach just anyone, you would stay to listen. Because what you're about to discover could explain why a cat chose you. Cats don't look for appearance, they look for soul. They don't approach out of sympathy, they approach through intuition. If a cat came into your life, it's not coincidence. It's because they sense your energy, your calm, your silent wound. In our monastery, we've always had cats. We never chose them, they chose us. People who connect with cats are different. They are deep, intuitive, healers without knowing it. They've learned to be alone without feeling empty. They have an aura that can't be faked, a light that few understand, but a cat does. They look at you as if they've known you from the soul, and they stay. Because in you, they sense something sacred. If you have a cat, don't ignore it. Maybe it came to remind you of something you forgot about yourself. Cats don't just accompany. They protect, transform, and balance the energy of those who have them near. They sit exactly where the energy is densest. They stare fixedly at where you cannot see. And when they curl up next to you, they're not seeking warmth. They're cleansing what you carry. But I want you to understand something. Your cat chose you because it felt your light, but also felt your wound. Cats approach people who have been carrying alone for too long, who gave so much they forgot about themselves, who smile on the outside, but inside carry a weight that no one sees. Your cat came to remind you that your soul deserves peace. But peace doesn't come just because a cat sits by your side. It comes when you learn to release what you carry. Write in the comments, I was chosen, if a cat chose you. And if you feel it's time to give your soul the peace that your cat already knows you deserve. I've been learning in silence for over 20 years how to find it, and everything I know is within the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
